Predicates:
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Name(x, y) ::: x is named after y.
Settlement(y) ::: y is a settlement.
Island(y) ::: y is an island.
PartOf(y, z) ::: y is part of z.
Continent(z) ::: z is a continent.
OnSouthwestCoast(x) ::: x is on the southwest coast.
SouthShetlandIslands(y) ::: y is the South Shetland Islands.
Includes(y, z) ::: y includes z.
Contains(y, z) ::: y contains z.
ConsideredPartOf(z, w) ::: z is considered part of w.
Implication: If A is in B and B is in C, then A is in C. (∀A, B, C (LocatedIn(A, B) ∧ LocatedIn(B, C) → LocatedIn(A, C))) 

Premises:
BarutinCove :: name of the cove
Settlement(barutin) ::: Barutin is a settlement
Bulgarian(barutin) ::: Barutin is a Bulgarian settlement
NamedAfter(barutin, barutin) ::: Barutin Cove is named after Barutin
LocatedIn(barutinCove, snowIsland) ::: Barutin Cove is on Snow Island
SouthShetlandIslands(southShetland) ::: The South Shetland Islands include Snow Island, Greenwich Island, and Deception Island
Includes(southShetland, snowIsland) ::: The South Shetland Islands include Snow Island
Includes(southShetland, greenwichIsland) ::: The South Shetland Islands include Greenwich Island
Includes(southShetland, deceptionIsland) ::: The South Shetland Islands include Deception Island
Continent(antarctica) ::: Antarctica is a continent
PartOf(snowIsland, antarctica) ::: Snow Island is part of Antarctica
PartOf(greenwichIsland, antarctica) ::: Greenwich Island is part of Antarctica
PartOf(deceptionIsland, antarctica) ::: Deception Island is part of Antarctica

Conclusion:
∃x ∃y (Name(x, y) ∧ Settlement(y) ∧ LocatedIn(x, y) ∧ PartOf(y, antarctica)) ::: There is at least one cove in Antarctica named after a place in Bulgaria
